verdict.rationale: Snyk ships a built-in agentic capability (Remediation Agent / DeepCode AI, accessible via IDE commands, CLI `snyk fix --agentic`, or MCP server) that autonomously scans, generates fix plans, applies fixes, and verifies results, effectively delegating remediation tasks to an AI assistant inside the product. A live probe confirms the MCP server actually starts and exposes tools/prompts, corroborating the documented agentic workflow.
